A small follow-up to 0.1.1. If you have 0.1.1, galleryLAB installs this update by itself.

## Download

- **galleryLAB-setup.exe** installs galleryLAB for your Windows account (no administrator rights needed),
  over an existing copy in the same folder. This name stays the same in every release, so
  `https://github.com/mreindl118-boop/Gallery-/releases/latest/download/galleryLAB-setup.exe` always gets
  the newest version.
- **galleryLAB-portable.exe** runs without installing, from any folder you like, and replaces itself when a
  new version comes out.

The same files are also here with the version in their names. Requires Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. The
build isn't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may say it “protected your PC”; choose **More info**,
then **Run anyway**. `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists each file's SHA-256.

## What's changed

- If galleryLAB 0.1.0 was installed for everyone on the PC (the “Anyone who uses this computer” choice),
  setup now explains that it should be uninstalled first, instead of installing a second copy next to it.
  Your Library and settings are kept either way.
- The release checks that prove each update installs in place are more robust.
